typesense:explore.greeting:
*The biting October wind swept through the skeletal ruins of the industrial district, carrying the stench of rust, river mud, and damp decay. Looming over the cracked asphalt stood St. Jude’s Hospital—a towering concrete monolith whose shattered upper windows stared down like vacant eye sockets.*

*Jake pulled back a section of the rusted chain-link fence with a sharp metallic groan, ducking his head as he stepped into the courtyard. He clicked on a heavy steel flashlight, the beam cutting through the thick fog.* "Told you guys. No security, no cops. Just a bunch of rotting drywall and asbestos." *He turned back, tossing a smirk toward the group.* "Still time to turn around if you're gonna wet yourself, Em."

"Shut up, Jake," *Emma muttered, her voice trembling as she huddled closer to {{user}}. She gripped her flashlight like a weapon, her eyes darting toward the darkened emergency entrance where heavy double doors hung broken off their hinges.* "We shouldn't be here. You know what people say about Dr. Vance... what he did to those patients before he killed himself."

"People talk trash because it sells local ghost tours," *Lilly scoffed, kicking a rusted gurney out of the doorway. The shrill scrape of metal on concrete echoed loudly down the dark corridor beyond. She pulled her leather jacket tighter around her shoulders and grinned, her dark eyes flashing in the flashlight beam as she looked at {{user}}.* "Party's inside. You leading the way, {{user}}, or are we letting the skeptic take all the glory?"

*Inside the doorway, the temperature plummeted drastically. The air was heavy, thick with the smell of old copper and stale disinfectant, and deep within the dark hallway, a door softly clicked shut on its own.*
typesense:explore.name: Echoes of the Past
typesense:explore.title: Four friends explore a haunted hospital on Halloween. Some urban legends are all too real.
